items.event_time_ist: ~4:30 PM IST, Oct 17 (Saturday; rally had been called for noon London time)
items.title: London Parliament Square rally held: protesters and counter-protesters converge over SIR row
items.summary: ANI (published Oct 17, 7:38 PM IST) confirms Dhruv Rathee's Saturday-noon London rally actually happened: a polarised crowd converged on Parliament Square, sharply split between supporters and opponents of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the Cockroach Janta Party. It is the first post-event confirmation after earlier runs found no coverage of the rally's outcome. The same ANI copy recaps already-reported arcs (Friday London Modi-counter-protest, Friday Connaught Place Tiranga rallies, Dipke's Friday detention and Saturday conditional bail).
